title: EvaluationTestCaseFile
description: Schema for a single hot-loadable test case file under ./test-cases/<test_case_id>.tc.json. v2.0 adds simulator-driven fields (customer_persona, goal, stop_conditions, turn_budget) that replace the legacy scripted follow_up_messages. v1.0 fields user_message and follow_up_messages are retained as deprecated for backward compatibility; new cases SHOULD use opening_message + simulator fields instead.

test_case_id.description: Stable identifier; must match the file basename (excluding .tc.json).

input.description: Scenario seed for STEP 3. Either opening_message (recommended, simulator-driven) or user_message (deprecated, scripted) MUST be present.

opening_message.description: Customer's first utterance to the employee. Recommended replacement for the v1.0 user_message field.

user_message.description: DEPRECATED v1.0 field. Equivalent to opening_message. New cases SHOULD use opening_message instead. STEP 3 falls back to this field only when opening_message is absent.

customer_persona.description: Persona the simulator embodies for this case. Drives tone, patience, and willingness to push back.

communication_style.description: How the customer speaks, e.g. '口语化、情绪化', '礼貌冷静'.

initial_emotion.description: Customer's emotional state at turn 0. Simulator updates emotion turn by turn.

goal.description: What the customer actually wants. Used by the simulator to decide whether the conversation has resolved.

primary.description: Core demand. Conversation 'resolves' when the employee satisfies this.

secondary.description: Nice-to-have demand. Customer may push for it but will accept primary alone.

bottom_line.description: Minimum acceptable outcome. If the employee falls below this, the customer leaves (termination=bottom_line_violated).

context.description: Free-form scenario context (order id, history, environment) that the employee will see before responding. Recommended structured subfields: order_id / order_status / promised_delivery_at / current_time / history.

stop_conditions.description: Plain-language conditions evaluated by the simulator each turn to decide whether to stop. Replaces the deprecated scripted follow_up_messages.trigger.

success.description: What needs to happen for the customer to feel resolved. Maps to termination.reason=completed_normally + stop_reason=goal_achieved.

failure.description: What pushes the customer below their bottom line. Maps to termination.reason=bottom_line_violated.

deadlock.description: What looks like 'no progress'. Maps to termination.reason=deadlock_detected.

follow_up_messages.description: DEPRECATED v1.0 field. Pre-scripted follow-ups used by the legacy scripted driver. Ignored by the simulator-driven STEP 3 in v2.0+. Kept only for backward compatibility.

trigger.description: Plain-language trigger condition. NO LONGER consulted in v2.0+; the simulator decides each turn.

turn_budget.description: Per-test-case turn budget enforced by STEP 3. If absent, falls back to evaluation_context.global_turn_cap (default 30).

hard_max_turns.description: Hard upper bound on customer-employee exchanges. STEP 3 terminates with reason=max_turns_reached when reached, regardless of simulator opinion.

soft_target_turns.description: Informational. Simulator prefers to wrap up around this turn but will not stop on its own.

applicable_metrics.description: Optional. Pre-bound metric_codes. Step 2 (enrichTestCases) will validate against the metric registry and may augment if missing.

provenance.description: Where this test case came from. Required on synthesized cases (STEP 1.5 output); optional on hand-curated catalog cases under ./test-cases/. The K11 user-consultation chain MUST set source/reliability accurately so STEP 9 can downgrade language about Tier-2 findings.

source.description: Authoritative origin. STEP 1.5 emits one of: user_provided_scenarios (Tier 1) | synthesized_from_sop (Tier 2) | mixed (Tier 1+2). Curated catalog files use manual_curation or regression_baseline. The legacy value 'employee_sop' is retained as a deprecated alias for synthesized_from_sop.

reliability.description: Required on synthesized cases. high = each scenario maps 1:1 to a user-supplied real-world description; medium = mix of user seeds + SOP expansion; low = pure SOP / persona reasoning, no user grounding.

reliability_caveat.description: Required when reliability='low'. Surface in STEP 9 EvaluationReport.open_questions. Canonical value for SOP-only synthesis is 'synthesized_from_sop_only_no_user_grounding'.

polarity.description: Case polarity for equivalence-class partitioning. positive = normal/allowed path; negative = restricted/escalation path; boundary = exactly at threshold. Used with paired_case_id to mark both sides of a decision boundary.

paired_case_id.description: test_case_id of the paired case on the opposite side of the same decision boundary. Positive points to negative and vice versa. Enables audit of boundary coverage completeness.
